{{Quote|With the Falcon's sensors, it's like seeing the future. You'll know where each Imperial fighter is headed before the TIE pilots have made a move.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
The [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] '''ANq-51 sensor array computer''' controlled the dorsal [[Rectenna/Legends|rectenna]] aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Its components included a power-boosted [[electro photo receptor]], a [[subspace comm detector]], and both active and passive long-range [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]]. Other systems could be patched into the [[Computer/Legends|computer]], including [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammers]], short range [[Targeting sensor/Legends|target acquisition programs]]. The array was augmented by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Identify Friend/Foe transponder|IFF transponder]] and a Fabritech [[ANy-20 active sensor transceiver/Legends|ANy-20 active sensor transceiver]].<ref name="EGWT" />
